name: Datacircle
summary: Free no-key API and MCP that list and rank GTM/data-API pricing plans; sheet and API answers are licensed CC BY 4.0.
description: Datacircle benchmarks go-to-market APIs and exposes the sheet through a public HTTP API and MCP. Verified 2026-11-11 without a key: GET https://api.datacircle.dev/v1 (index of calls), OpenAPI at /v1/openapi.json, GET /v1/apis returned a list of 145 API rows, and MCP initialize 200 at https://api.datacircle.dev/mcp (serverInfo datacircle 2.0.0). llms.txt and terms exist. Terms (updated 2026-11-06) state anyone can download the sheet (CSV/JSON/zip) and call the API and MCP with no key; both the file and API/MCP answers are under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to Datacircle; 60 calls per minute per IP; figures come from providers and can change — check the provider's own page before buying. Datacircle is not a party to purchases from listed providers. Vendor-affiliated listing (#33, wayne@datacircle.dev).

agent_access.notes: No API key. Terms state a 60 requests/minute per-IP limit. Attribution required under CC BY 4.0. JSON-RPC initialize POST to https://api.datacircle.dev/mcp returned 200 (serverInfo datacircle 2.0.0); GET/HEAD of that URL 308 to https://datacircle.dev/docs/mcp (documentation page, not used as the MCP endpoint here).
